purpose: Train the fresh two-agent R3 baseline with reward v3 unchanged while isolating official-MAPPO-style value normalization and normalized Huber critic regression.

parameter_rationale.causal_scope: R3 holds reward v3, action v2, Actor architecture, Critic architecture, scenarios, learning rates, PPO epochs, batch use, gamma, GAE lambda, clipping and gradient clipping fixed; only Critic target scaling and regression loss change.
parameter_rationale.value_semantics: The critic emits normalized values; every rollout value and bootstrap is denormalized before GAE so advantages and returns retain reward units.
parameter_rationale.statistics: A single pooled scalar ValueNorm is appropriate because the critic is shared and agent-conditioned; moments update once from the complete active-agent return batch before any minibatch, preventing minibatch-order-dependent target drift.
parameter_rationale.defaults: beta=0.99999, epsilon=1e-5 and variance_floor=1e-2 match the official MAPPO ValueNorm implementation defaults and numerical floor.
parameter_rationale.loss: Huber delta=10 is the official MAPPO default in normalized units and limits domination by sparse collision or success target outliers without changing their reward semantics.
parameter_rationale.checkpoint: Running moments and debiasing state are first-class checkpoint state so resume preserves exact value decoding and subsequent target normalization.
parameter_rationale.acceptance: R3 must demonstrate finite normalized targets, correct denormalized GAE/bootstrap semantics, restorable normalizer state, lower Critic gradient clipping pressure, and improved held-batch fit without using policy performance to tune these constants.
parameter_rationale.seed_policy: Seed 42 remains the single engineering pilot seed; CARLA scripted diagnostics are mechanism checks, not a performance-selection pilot.
